name: Carmel Clay Schools
districtFact: Carmel Clay Schools publishes its annual district calendars as Google documents. Families also need the live building calendars for late starts, elementary conference details, and the Blue/Gold or Red/White rotation used at Carmel High School and the three middle schools.

districtFaqs.q: Does the Carmel Clay district calendar include Blue/Gold and middle-school rotation days?
districtFaqs.a: No. The annual district calendar covers major districtwide dates. Carmel High School publishes a separate Blue/Gold calendar, and each middle school publishes its own color-day rotation through the CCS school calendars page.

districtFaqs.q: What changes on a Carmel Clay Schools late-start day?
districtFaqs.a: CCS starts every school level 40 minutes later while keeping the regular dismissal time. Elementary school begins at 8:20 a.m., middle school at 9:05 a.m., and high school at 9:45 a.m. on a late-start day.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families check for Carmel Clay calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official CCS District Calendar page for the annual Google documents, live district events, school calendars, bell times, and calendar subscription instructions. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and does not update automatically when CCS changes a source.
